## Design

### 2026-10-10 – I used KiCad to create the schematic for the Starbie. Added Xiao-ESP32-C3 microcontroller , 2 SW_PUSH, generic 01x04 pin for OLED, generic 01x10 for MPU6050, DHT11 sensor and 10k resistor to go with i

**1h**

I used KiCad to create the schematic for the Starbie. Added Xiao-ESP32-C3 microcontroller , 2 SW_PUSH, generic 01x04 pin for OLED, generic 01x10 for MPU6050, DHT11 sensor and 10k resistor to go with it. It took me a long time as I have never done proper PCB design before and this was my first serious go at it. Learnt how to use nets and add power symbols. Used Youtube to understand why the components are connected how they are. next step, footprints and wiring up the PCB. also i dont know why but  i had to import a 10k resistor from snap eda. ok bye
